title: hadolint on every Dockerfile, three configuration scans per image (plan 10 row 10G-41)
note: basis 'hypothesis' for the hadolint rows: the rules were read from the Dockerfiles, not reported by hadolint (not run here); the pull request's CI images job is the first run.

findings.claim: deploy/docker/db.Dockerfile:53 installs ca-certificates without a version (hadolint DL3008, warning); it comes at the version of the digest-pinned trixie suite like the base's own packages; an inline ignore with its reason at db.Dockerfile:38 (D-1343); pinning it is open

RUN steps with pipes and no pipefail SHELL (hadolint DL4006, warning): deploy/docker/db.Dockerfile:43 (pg_config | grep -q and the key checks) and deploy/docker/backup.Dockerfile:40, 48, 49; ignores with reasons at db.Dockerfile:38 and backup.Dockerfile:35; a pipefail SHELL changes how the build runs (pg_config | grep -q can fail on SIGPIPE) and needs a build of both images to prove

tools/rehearse_box/host.Dockerfile:27 installs the rehearsal host's packages without versions (hadolint DL3008, warning); the ignore with its reason is at host.Dockerfile:16 (a comment only; H-54's digest and fetch settings unchanged), and the comment changes the file's hash, so the rehearsal rebuilds its cached host image once

two rules hadolint is expected to raise on purpose: SC2046 at deploy/docker/backup.Dockerfile:48 (the package list from go list must split into words) and DL3006 at deploy/docker/db.Dockerfile:23 (FROM ${POSTGRES_BASE}, pinned by digest through its ARG, as in D-206); each an inline ignore with its reason

deploy/docker/embed.Dockerfile: the SC2086 ignore sat above three comment lines, so it reached no instruction (hadolint applies a pragma to the line under it), and pip install had no --no-cache-dir (DL3042, warning; the base sets PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1, so the image is unchanged); the pragma now sits on the RUN (embed.Dockerfile:23) and the flag is at :26

none of the three tools was run here: hadolint (fetching and running a binary was refused in the session that made this card), Trivy secret and misconfiguration and Dockle (no Docker daemon); the first hadolint run on the five newly linted Dockerfiles is the pull request's CI images job (gating: a rule not read here turns it red), the first image scans the image gates' job on a train (report-only)

the image configuration scan gates at HIGH from 2026-12-17 (D-1343) only when a pull request sets IMAGE_SCAN_ARGS="--fail-at HIGH" and removes continue-on-error in trialbox-images.yml; the four weeks' findings are triaged first (fixed, or a dated ledger entry by decision)
the two Dockerfiles of the repository outside trialbox/ (Dockerfile and .devcontainer/Dockerfile at the root, the upstream project's) are not linted: TrialBox's tooling neither builds nor ships them

docs/validation/ssdf-iec81001.csv:41 and docs/security/11-secure-development-mapping.md:135 still say hadolint checks 3 of the 6 Dockerfiles (SSDF PW.6.2 'partly'); after the first green CI run they can say 8 of 8 and name the image scans

the release-tag multiarch job does not run the image configuration scan on the pushed registry images (py, jvm by digest); they are built from the same Dockerfiles the images job scans on both platforms, so only a registry-side difference would be missed
